'''Nido''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who resided on [[Vaced/Legends|Vaced]]. In [[43 ABY]], [[Tobb Jadak]] and [[Flitcher Poste]] arrived on Vaced in search of [[Quip Fargil]]. They encountered Nido at the [[Vaced Spaceport]] and the Rodian gave the pair the directions to Fargil's cabin.<ref name="Millennium Falcon" />
